title: ChatMessagePush @type value not registered with IANA
description: The IANA section registers the capability URN urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:push but does not register the @type string value 'ChatMessagePush'. If JMAP has a registry for object type strings, this value needs an entry there.
close_reason: Not applicable: RFC 8620 does not establish an @type registry. No IANA registration needed for ChatMessagePush @type value.
